changelog: v0.6.5: Deploy loading screen — deploying no longer looks frozen. A staged DEPLOYING screen now shows real progress on every deploy path (single player, modes, multiplayer host/join, puzzles), and if a stage ever hangs, its label stays frozen in place so you can see exactly where it got stuck. Also fixed under the hood: the web warmup's pool precache silently failed in the real game (pools stayed lazy — warmup's whole point), warmup emitters could damage real enemies, puzzle deploy wrongly started a WaveManager, and deploy now validates before freeing the menu (fixes a black-screen bug). Web build updated too.
